load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained model weights from a file path or URL into a PyTorch model
fix_random_seeds: fix all random seeds for torch, cuda, numpy, and python random to a given value
get_sha: get the current git sha, branch name, and uncommitted changes status as a string
create_CosineScheduler: create a cosine learning rate scheduler with optional warmup and freeze periods for training
has_batchnorms: check if a PyTorch model contains any BatchNorm1d, BatchNorm2d, BatchNorm3d, or SyncBatchNorm layers
